title: High strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement-

regulatory_compliance.qco_order: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2024

clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers the requirements of deformed steel bars and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete, in the following strength grades: a) Fe415,Fe415D; b) Fe 500, Fe SOQD; c) Fe 550, Fe 550D; and d) Fe 600. NOTES 1 Ths Tigures following' the s^rnbol F? indiCiitc th? sncc^ficd minimum 0.2 percent proof stress or yield stress in N/mm-. 2 The letter D following the strength grade indicates the category with same specified minimum 0.2 percent proof stress/yield stres.s but with enhanced specified minimum percentage elongation. 1 .2 This standard allows the chemical composition and carbon equivalent to be limited so that the material can be readily welded by conventional welding procedures. Material not conforming to these limits is generally difficult to weld for which special care and precautions will have to be exercised, 1.3 This standard applies to hot-rolled steel without subsequent treatment, or to hot-rolled steel with controlled cooling and tempering and to cold-worked steel. The production process is at the discretion of the manufacturer. 1 .4 This standard also applies to reinforcing bars and wires supplied in coil form but the requirements of this Indian Standard apply to the straightened product. 1 .5 Tuis standard also applies to remforcing bars and wires which may be subsequently coated. 1.6 Deformed bars produced by re-rolling finished products such as plates and rails (virgin or used or scrap), or by rolling material for which the metallurgical history is not fully documented or not known, are not acceptable as per this Indian Standard.
